title: docs(skills): the schema-expressions guide says a faulted or stored-blank field rule refuses the submit (objectui#11256)
body:
Fixes #11256
Clause-②: no

Docs only, on the governed `skills/**` surface (Tier H: this PR stays a draft until an authorized APPROVED review; the seat lands it). One paragraph of `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md` changes — the one beginning "Renderer-side, and only here" in the section "Field-level conditional rules" — plus one empty-frontmatter changeset. No other passage is edited: the sibling card objectui#11414's region ("Which components read `bind`") is untouched, and `origin/main` (`549aaa83`) was merged into the branch before this PR opened, without conflict. Dispatched work (claim on the card, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01FNKm1SmPpuJASnbjxWGtsJ`); draft is the delivered state.

## What the passage said, and what it says now

Before, on `main` at `0858267e`: "Evaluation is **fail-open** -- a broken predicate never hides content, never blocks submit and never locks a field -- so `visibleWhen` is never a security boundary on the client."

Now, restated from ADR-0137 (objectstack `docs/adr/0137-predicate-fault-semantics-are-contract.md`, Accepted), as PR objectui#11233 landed it for objectui#8069:

- D3, render: a broken predicate is fail-open — it never hides content and never locks a field, so the field stays drawn.
- D2, submit: a faulted or stored-blank field rule refuses the submit, naming the field and the rule. One judge per rule, as ruled on objectui#8069: the client judges `visibleWhen`; a faulted `requiredWhen` / `readonlyWhen` is the server's refusal, shown beside the input.
- D1, authoring: a blank triad key is refused.
- D4, gates: a blank gate stays "no gate", with a diagnostic.
- Kept: `visibleWhen` is still never a security boundary on the client; the server is the authority.

The paragraph's first three lines (reactive re-evaluation via `resolveFieldRuleState`; the static `required: true` / `readonly: true` floor) are unchanged, and nothing was re-wrapped.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured on the tree rather than taken from the card

- ① The passage on objectui `origin/main` was byte-identical to the card's quotation (read at `0858267e` before editing).
- ② PR objectui#11233 (merge commit `af9e9572`, 2026-09-30) lands the D2 refusal on three submit paths — `form.tsx` (`handleSubmit`, before react-hook-form validation), the console `FormPage` (`findSubmitRefusals`) and `WizardForm` (`gateFinalSubmit`) — each reading `faults.visibleWhen` off `resolveFieldRuleState`. The refusal text is the `form.visibleWhenFaulted` key in `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`: "Can't submit: the visibleWhen rule of {{fields}} could not be evaluated. The rule must be fixed before this form can be submitted." Pins: `visibleWhen-fault-refuses-submit-8069.test.tsx`, `FormPage.visibleWhenFault-8069.test.tsx`, `wizardVisibleWhenFault-8069.test.tsx`. The client refuses only `visibleWhen`; a faulted `requiredWhen` / `readonlyWhen` is let through to the server, whose D2 envelope (`VALIDATION_FAILED`, `code: 'rule_violation'`, `constraint.reason: 'unevaluable'`, `constraint.rule` naming the slot) lands beside the field — the end-to-end server pin in the same components test file. That is why the new text says "the client judges `visibleWhen`, the server the other two" rather than "the client refuses every field rule".
- ③ "A blank triad key is refused at authoring": pinned by `packages/types/src/__tests__/base-schema-predicate-envelope-7530.test.ts`, describe `FormFieldSchema.%s refuses a blank predicate (objectui#8069, ADR-0137 D1)`, which asserts the spec's own `EVALUATED_EXPRESSION_SOURCE_REQUIRED` message at the key. "A blank gate stays no gate, with a diagnostic": pinned by `packages/core/src/evaluator/__tests__/fieldRuleFaults-8069.test.ts`, describe `ADR-0137 D4 — silencer 2: hasDeclaredPredicate folding a blank gate` (the `[blank]` report), implemented by `reportBlankGate` in `packages/core/src/evaluator/declaredPredicate.ts`. Both verified on the tree; nothing is written as unverified.
- ④ The later bullet "a field-level `visibleWhen` fails open. Do not generalise from one to another." (under "CEL predicates over a row record") describes the render-side direction (D3) and is still true; it is not edited (see Acceptance notes).

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- The later bullet "a field-level `visibleWhen` fails open. Do not generalise from one to another." is render-side (D3) and remains true. With the submit refusal now stated two paragraphs above it, a hurried reader could take "fails open" as the whole story; the bullet's own topic is failure DIRECTION at render across surfaces, so it is left as is, as the card asks. carrier: none — noted, not filed.
- `git grep -n 'never blocks submit' origin/main` returns nothing: objectui#11233 had already corrected `content/docs/guide/metadata-diagnostics.md` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx`, and this passage was the last shipped sentence teaching the old behaviour.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:只改了已发布技能 `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md` 中「字段级条件规则」一节以「Renderer-side, and only here」开头的那一段,外加一个空 frontmatter 的 changeset。旧文说「坏掉的谓词永不阻止提交」;新文按 ADR-0137 重述:渲染期照常画出字段(不隐藏、不锁定),提交期求值失败或存储为空白的字段规则拒绝这次提交并点名字段与规则(`visibleWhen` 由客户端判,`requiredWhen` / `readonlyWhen` 由服务端判),空白三元键在编写期被拒,空白 gate 视为无 gate 并出一次诊断;「不是客户端安全边界、服务端仍是权威」保留。净增 3 行。

**为什么改**:PR objectui#11233(objectui#8069)已于 2026-09-30 把提交期拒绝落到三条提交路径,这份技能文档却还在教相反的行为;AI 按这份指南写元数据,会不预期提交被拒。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯文档,不发版(changeset 为空 frontmatter);风险只在措辞是否准确,每一句都对应树上的实现与 pin 测试(见上文)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
